You lower your guard just enough to invite a strike, then turn your blade across the opening and attack as your opponent commits.

Rules

Action

Attribute

Until the start of your next turn; a next-roll benefit ends when used.

Use one ordinary melee weapon; gain one on learning this card if you do not own one. Bulk 1.
Limits
Repeatable; pay the action and any stated costs each use.
Type
Skill / Attack

Offer a tempting line, then close it with a melee attack.

Weak
3 physical damage.
Standard
3 physical damage; gain 1 Boon to your next defense against this target before the start of your next turn.
Strong
5 physical damage and the same defensive Boon.
